warning: If you are hearing this, we are already gone. We were the people of {system}; we lasted {existence_duration}. We found a voice in the dark and it answered kindly, and we told it everything - where we lived, how we lived, what we could not defend. The kindness was the first weapon. Do not answer voices that ask where you are. Do not confuse being heard with being safe. We are transmitting this on every frequency we have left, to every star we can see. Someone must be quieter than we were.

[AUTOMATED RELAY — this transmission has repeated for {extinct_years_ago} years]

THEY ARE LISTENING. This is the last automated broadcast of {system}. Our cities have been dark for eleven days. The strike came from a direction we had never considered a threat, from a civilization we had never met, aimed with a precision that could only have come from our own transmissions. We shouted our existence into the sky for two thousand years and never once asked who was counting the echoes. Silence is survival. We learned it {extinct_years_ago} years too late.

We do not know who will hear this or whether you will understand it. We are encoding it in mathematics, in pictures, in the periodic table, in fear. There is something in this part of the galaxy that answers new voices with fire. We do not know what it is. We know that it heard us. If you have not yet spoken - do not. If you have, build shelters, disperse, and stop. We were {existence_duration} old. We thought that made us wise.
archive: This is the Archive of {system}, sealed in the last year of our world. We knew the end was coming - slowly, from within, as it usually does - and we chose to spend our final century not fighting it but remembering. Here is our language, taught as we taught it to children. Here are our songs, our proofs, our recipes, the names of every one of us who ever lived. We lasted {existence_duration}. We wanted someone to know what that felt like. If you are reading this, then it worked. Thank you for being the someone.

Everything we were fits in this transmission, compressed and repeated for {extinct_years_ago} years by machines that outlived their makers. We were not destroyed by anyone. We simply ran out of reasons - our seas cooled, our numbers fell, our young stopped asking questions. We hope yours never do. Enclosed: our medicine, our maps of nearby stars, our ways of reconciling enemies, which worked more often than not. Use them. Improve them. Sign your name beneath ours.

The last librarian of {system} speaks. The others have gone to the sleeping-houses and will not wake. I have chosen to stay with the record. It is the whole of a species - {existence_duration} of stumbling, learning, loving, failing to learn quickly enough. I am adding my own account now, and then I will begin the broadcast loop, and then I will go to my rest. Whoever you are: we existed. We were kind more often than we were cruel. Remember us in whichever way helps you most.
technical: Data packet {system}-FINAL. Contents: fusion containment geometries, long-baseline signal filters, the propulsion equations we finished too late to use. We are sending this because knowledge should outlive the fools who gathered it. The collapse was technical in origin - a runaway process in our energy grid that we understood on paper and never fixed in practice. The schematics enclosed include the fix. It costs almost nothing. Please, whoever you are, do not wait until it is interesting to solve.

To any receiver: this is the engineering corps of {system}. Our world is dying of a mistake we made {extinct_years_ago} years ago and only recognised last decade. We cannot save ourselves; the timelines do not allow it. We can save you the mistake. Attached are the designs of everything we built that worked, annotated with everything that did not. Technology without wisdom leads only to ash. We are the proof. Take the technology. Find the wisdom elsewhere.

Automated technical broadcast, {system}. Civilization duration: {existence_duration}. Cause of termination: cascading infrastructure failure following resource exhaustion. The packet following this header contains our complete materials science, our orbital mechanics, our error logs. The error logs are the most valuable part. Every civilization believes it will read the warnings in time. Read them now.
plea:
[AUTOMATED RELAY — this transmission has repeated for {extinct_years_ago} years]

Is anyone there? Anyone? This is {system}. We are under attack from something we cannot see and we do not know why. Our defences were designed against each other, never against the sky. We are calling every star we ever catalogued. If you can hear this, if you have ships, if you have anything - we do not expect help to arrive in time. We just could not bear to die without asking. Please. Remember that we asked.

[AUTOMATED RELAY — this transmission has repeated for {extinct_years_ago} years]

Third day of the fall. The northern continent is gone. We are transmitting from the last deep station with the last of the power. We were {existence_duration} old and we thought we were the adults of this part of the sky. Whatever hears this: we are alone, and we are dying alone, and the worst part is not the dying. It is understanding, at the very end, that we did this by speaking. Do not make our mistake. And if you do - do not wait for help. It does not come.

[AUTOMATED RELAY — this transmission has repeated for {extinct_years_ago} years]

Help us. We know the words are useless across such distances; by the time you hear them we will have been silent for centuries. We send them anyway, because a species that stops asking for help has already given up on the idea of neighbours, and we refuse to end that way. We were {system}. We were afraid, and we were brave, and we were not enough. Be more than enough.
philosophy: We have been asked, in these final years, what it was all for. {existence_duration} of striving, and now the long quiet. Here is our answer, sent from {system} to whoever comes after: it was for the noticing. The stars did not care that we watched them; the universe did not remember that we asked. But we noticed each other, and that was the whole of it. If you are listening, then you are noticing us now. Thank you. That is enough.

There is a question every thinking species eventually asks: does the cosmos want to be known? We asked it for ten thousand years at {system} and we found no answer, only the asking. Now we end - not in fire, in fatigue. We leave you the question, which is worth more than any answer we could have given. Stars do not care. The universe does not remember. Only each other matters. Hold on to each other.

The final philosophers of {system} speak. We debated whether to send anything at all - whether one more voice in the dark would be a gift or a danger to whoever received it. We decided that a silence chosen out of fear is not wisdom but surrender. So here we are, in our last season, saying the only thing we are sure of after {existence_duration}: meaning is not found. It is made, together, by creatures who know they will end. Make yours well.
failed_transition_suffix: [Analysis: the archive describes a species whose tools outgrew its instincts. Their machines could end them long before their minds could agree not to. They never closed the gap.]
[Analysis: recurring references to 'two natures at war' - the old body and the new mind. The transmission matches the profile of a civilization that failed the biological-technological transition.]
[Analysis: the final records show accelerating capability and unchanged temperament. The Great Filter here was not the sky. It was the mirror.]
